Vendored third-party scripts used by ../petstore-ui.html (MIT, ISC and SIL OFL 1.1 licenses; see the root LICENSE file).

  react.production.min.js      React 18.3.1      https://unpkg.com/react@18.3.1/umd/react.production.min.js
  react-dom.production.min.js  ReactDOM 18.3.1   https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18.3.1/umd/react-dom.production.min.js

Unmodified copies of the upstream UMD production bundles, so the demo page loads with no network access.

Export libraries for the console's DataTables Excel and PDF buttons (served by the console's /export route):

  jszip.min.js     JSZip 3.10.1    npm jszip@3.10.1   dist/jszip.min.js   (MIT)
  pdfmake.min.js   pdfMake 0.2.20  npm pdfmake@0.2.20 build/pdfmake.min.js (MIT)
  vfs_fonts.js     pdfMake 0.2.20  npm pdfmake@0.2.20 build/vfs_fonts.js  (embeds Roboto, SIL OFL 1.1)

Unmodified upstream builds.
